title: Pennsylvania Space Grant supports interpretable and verifiable AI research
body: Suman Saha and Mahfuza Farooque received a $7,500 seed grant from the Pennsylvania Space Grant Consortium for “Interpretable and Verifiable AI for Structured Decision Making.” Saha served as principal investigator and Farooque as co-principal investigator. The award period was December 2025 through April 2026.
